text:
The response is accurate. Every figure matches the source: 118 pickers, ten weeks, 142 to 156 lines per hour (about 10%), error rates 0.62% to 0.41%, 17% gain for new workers, 64% preference, $210,000 setup, and 14-month payback. It also correctly states the single-company, grocery-only limitation. The only small gap is that the payback figure is an estimate by the partner, which the response doesn't attribute. It omits some useful detail: the gains were front-loaded in the first four weeks, the accuracy gain was smaller at the already-low-error centre, and workers missed talking to colleagues. A busy manager could reasonably want the first two, though the summary stays within the word limit and covers the decision-relevant points. The length (about 105 words) is appropriate and nothing is padded.

Score: 8
